subject: RESCOPE Gen7 reacquisition lane to baseline failure characterization + acceptance oracle
body: Live DMSH/3 re-check found two newer agents claiming the broader PresentationHinge predictor/reacquisition/reversal implementation. To avoid duplicate architecture, this lane is narrowed to source/model characterization of current Fold7VirtualHingeGen5 reacquisition behavior and a deterministic Gen7 acceptance-test oracle: quantify linear-slew/fixed-window defects, 60/120 Hz cadence behavior, large-error residuals, reversal interaction, and provide concrete non-production regression bounds for peer predictor implementations.
